title: Birthday, Welcome and Anniversary Bonuses: Paloma Rewards Tier Table
content:
Paloma Rewards credits occasion bonuses in the member's birth month, when a tier is first reached and on each membership anniversary, and limits the bonus points credited in any rolling 30 calendar days.

| Tier | Birthday bonus (points, once a year in the birth month) | Birthday bonus needs a completed qualifying transfer in the trailing 12 months | Tier welcome bonus (points, once on first reaching the tier) | Anniversary bonus (points, each membership anniversary) | Most bonus points credited in a rolling 30 calendar days |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paloma Rewards Blue | 0 | Yes | 0 | 0 | 1500 |
| Paloma Rewards Silver | 50 | Yes | 100 | 0 | 1500 |
| Paloma Rewards Gold | 100 | Yes | 200 | 100 | 2500 |
| Paloma Rewards Platinum | 150 | Yes | 300 | 150 | 3500 |
| Paloma Rewards Diamond | 200 | Yes | 500 | 250 | 5000 |
| Paloma Rewards Elite | 300 | Yes | 1000 | 400 | 8000 |

## Notes on the table

- The 30-day limit in the last column covers bonus points of every kind other than goodwill: the referring member's and the referred customer's referral bonuses, birthday, tier welcome and anniversary bonuses. Goodwill points granted by an agent are excluded from it.
- A tier whose figure is 0 pays no bonus of that kind: Paloma Rewards Blue pays no birthday, welcome or anniversary bonus, and Paloma Rewards Silver pays no anniversary bonus.
- On every tier the birthday bonus is conditional on a completed qualifying transfer in the trailing 12 months.
- Hypothetical illustration: a member who first reaches Paloma Rewards Platinum receives a welcome bonus of 300 points for that tier.
